name: update_member
title: Change a team member
description:
Change a member's role between manager and agent, or deactivate or reactivate them. A deactivated member
cannot sign in and their connected assistants stop working; reactivating takes a seat. Nobody can be made
an admin here, and another admin can only be deactivated or reactivated.

is_active.description: false deactivates them, true reactivates them.
